question: How does omitting the praṇava alter the previously stated mantra?
premises: The previously stated mantra is taken as the base
The praṇava is omitted from it
The resulting form has six syllables
inference: By omitting the praṇava, the previously stated mantra becomes a six-syllabled mantra.
plain_english: By omitting the praṇava, this very previously stated mantra becomes six-syllabled.
